name: kube-flexbox
description: Kube CSS/SCSS framework with grid replaced by flexbox-grid

scripts.build: npm run build:compile && npm run build:concat && npm run build:copy && npm run build:prefix && npm run build:minify && npm run build:js
scripts.build:concat: cat src/flexbox-grid/dist/flexboxgrid.css dist/_kube.css > dist/kube-flexbox.scss && rm dist/_kube.css
scripts.build:js: cp src/kube/dist/js/kube.js dist/kube-flexbox.js && cp src/kube/dist/js/kube.min.js dist/kube-flexbox.min.js

author: Andre OBrien (https://andreobrien.me)
